summary: Jogel home kit launched 14 July 2026, debut in the Russian Super Cup on 18 July 2026. Gazprom on the front (also the only sponsor on the retail shirt); Winline WIN patch on the right chest and a WINLINE patch on the sleeve; MegaFon patch on the left shoulder; Aeroflot sleeve patch. No back-of-shirt or shorts sponsor: the launch photos and the club shop product photos show only the crest, Jogel marks, player numbers and the RPL champion badge.
